p0_findings.finding: The analyzer gathers self attributes only from direct assignments to a hard-coded variable set. A synthetic cache=self.update_value; spike=cache counterexample passes its intersection test. The frozen forward also calls a dynamic _h9_calibration_observer before activation and passes self.thresh.detach(), whose shared storage can be mutated by an unconstrained callback.
p0_findings.impact: The unconditional current-x-plus-frozen-parameters output-dependency claim is not proven. Training-side threshold_update can additionally turn observer state into cross-forward parameter changes unless explicitly disabled.
p0_findings.required_fix: Bind a frozen inference instance/config requiring no calibration hook and no threshold updater, and implement recursive def-use including predicates, calls, getattr and callback purity; state the result conditionally on frozen inference.

p0_findings.finding: The 8515 arithmetic is a selected mixed subset, not payload excluding tags/order/control. It already contains 867 tag/beat bits through the 147-bit product/FIFO entries, while omitting 1109 decoded configuration bits and other tags/order/control. Exact RTL declarations total 10470 sequential bits before optimization; M289 retains 9639 one-bit sequential cells.
p0_findings.impact: The current paper-safe 8515-bit statement is internally inconsistent and cannot be used as total working-state or physical-FF accounting.
p0_findings.required_fix: Relabel 8515 as a selected subset with exact inclusions/exclusions or remove it; report 10470 declared-bit upper bound and 9639 synthesized sequential cells as different metrics.

go_conditions: training-side threshold_update and optimizer updates are disabled

p1_findings.finding: Required fragments and four forbidden names do not prove port completeness, liveness or overwrite-before-read. Manual audit of the exact pinned RTL supports the conditional result.
p1_findings.fix: Use a structured port/register/liveness table and later bind release/drain SVA.

p1_findings.finding: Release clears config_loaded but does not physically clear payload/tag/config registers.
p1_findings.fix: Say no live/valid state survives, not no state or bits survive.

p1_findings.finding: The M289 same-source area fact is true and independently recomputed, but M515 freezes only a macro-mapping JSON rather than the M289 contract, manifest, area report, netlist and M302 review.
p1_findings.fix: Add those exact identities to the revised contract/analyzer result.

p1_findings.finding: M273 is a T10 rank3 tile engine. T2 is only counted in trace/algorithm, and network-wide weight/config backing plus activation storage are outside the audited module.
p1_findings.fix: Scope the claim to the M273 T10 standalone boundary and list local config registers separately from system backing storage.

inside: per-context config capture and decoded factor/bias/threshold registers
tile-local raw, intermediate, product and FIFO state
outside: network-wide weight/config backing store and delivery
input/output activation buffers and NoC/DRAM traffic

paper_safe_statement: With calibration hooks and training-time threshold updates disabled, the frozen ATLIF forward maps each complete temporal tile independently. The exact M273 T10 RTL accepts context release only after all live ownership, pipeline, and result-FIFO state has drained; stale payload bits remain unobservable. Thus this standalone boundary requires no spatially indexed or cross-frame membrane-state SRAM. The exact-source M289 logic-only netlist contains 9,639 sequential standard-cell cells and zero macros; network-wide weight/config and activation storage, Fixed comparison, trained rank-3 accuracy, power, and system performance remain outside this claim.

decision.next_action: Repair the static analyzer and accounting labels, bind frozen inference and M289 evidence, regenerate and independently re-review without running EDA or GPU.
